title: ★ Cab ride 🇨🇭St. Moritz - 🇮🇹Tirano (Bernina pass), Switzerland to Italy [10.2019]
summary: A two-hour driver's-eye cab ride along the Bernina railway from St. Moritz in Switzerland to Tirano in Italy. The UNESCO-listed line crosses the Alps at high altitude with steep adhesion gradients.
why: Recommended as relaxing slow-TV, a long scenic video to unwind with.

quote.text: Some of my favorite long ones. They are incredibly relaxing.
